- Immediately play any winning move (reach opponent home row) or any capturing move that wins material decisively.
- Use iterative deepening alpha-beta search with a heuristic evaluation combining material, advancement (how close pieces are to promotion), mobility, and piece safety (threatened pieces).
- Order moves to try captures and promotions first to speed up searching.
- Use a short time limit (safe for the arena) to ensure a result is always returned; if time runs out, the best move found so far is used.
- Always return a legal move.

- Heuristic evaluation favors:
  - Material (piece count difference).
  - Advancement toward the goal row (pieces closer to promotion are better).
  - Mobility (number of legal moves).
  - Center control.
- Move ordering prefers promotions and captures first to improve pruning and play strength.
- The implementation ensures at least one legal move is returned.
